summary: Frontend-only e2e at 360x780 and 600x1000 (8 Playwright runs) covering the Wider Rival Pool and Ultra FX graphics. One CRITICAL bug was found and hot-fixed: a render crash (createRadialGradient non-finite) froze every seed-9001 battle at about t2298. After the fix, everything requested passes with 0 console errors and 0 pageerrors. RIVAL POOL: Arena data-pool for L1..L6 is unlocked/unlocked/nextTier/nextTier/line/all, the L5/L6 texts match, and the label reads 'Lv.6 · Legend'. __rivalTest([6,94,25,143,130,65],3,2024) gives power 495 and budgets 396/446/495/545/594/644. Avg BST per level: L1 430, L2 484, L3 527, L4 527, L5 559, L6 604. L1/L2 have no locked picks. L3/L4 have 1 locked pick (Milotic). L5 [line] has 3 locked picks (Arcanine, Tyranitar, Metagross) and is fully evolved 6/6. L6 [all] is fully evolved 6/6 (Metagross, Dragonite, Slaking, Tyranitar, Garchomp, Arcanine). LIVE seed 777 (totalWins 0, power 489): L6 NPC Rhyperior/Mamoswine/Metagross/Tyranitar/Dragonite/Garchomp, avg BST ~578, meta.rival {pool:'all', tierPicks:6, level:6, budget 636}. L1 NPC Munchlax/Gligar/Anorith/Ponyta/Farfetch'd/Mawile, avg ~386, a difference of ~192. The HUD shows 'BRAWLER · LV.6' and 'LV.1'. Arena Start Battle at L6 (random seed) gave Jolteon/Charizard/Porygon-Z/Magmortar/Sceptile/Espeon (avg ~532), pool 'all'. GFX SETTINGS: default Ultra (data-level ultra), radios have correct aria-checked, Low updates the blurb and localStorage {level:'low',auto:true}, persists on reload, and the auto toggle persists false/true. Reset to Ultra at the end. ULTRA battle 9001: quality ultra, cap 700, ambient 42 (motes), __fxCount line includes quality=ultra, fps 60-61 (55 at 4x). Mid-fight effectCount reached 283 at 4x. effectCount was 0 at 2.5s after end, with ambient 42. LIVE SWITCH: low gives cap 90, additive false, ambient 0. High gives cap 320, ambient 18. Ultra restores 700/42. The tick kept advancing (182→282). GOVERNOR: auto true, quality stayed ultra for 10s at 60fps, and no 'Graphics lowered' toast appeared. AMBIENT: pitch=pollen 42, shoreline=glint 15, snowfield=snow 42, cavern=motes 42. DETERMINISM: ultra vs low (set through localStorage before navigating) both end with winner player at tick 6690 with an identical inputLog. Reduced motion also gives 6690 player, with reducedMotion true, muted true, ambient 0 and 0 particles. NOTE: the 7608 endTick from the brief is out of date. It comes from iteration_6, before the rival-level AI skill slot existed. The current save rivalLevel 2 gives 6690; rivalLevel 3 gives 7620 and rivalLevel 4 gives 7429. All of these are consistent across graphics presets, so this is not a render regression. EFFECT MOMENTS (600x1000): hit pause shows plume/areaFlash/scorch. area-detonate shows pulse/fog/scorch. switch-in shows lightColumn plus 'GO KADABRA!'. Canvas luminance stayed ~55 with <1% white or black, so there is no composite-mode leakage, and it stays stable after resume. REGRESSION: Bag thunder-stone makes unit0 creatureId 26 with the 'Pikachu evolved into Raichu!' toast. Battle 4242 ends player at t7779, the result shows the species credit table, the Save page bag panel renders, and a post-win drop gave metal-coat.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL (fixed by testing agent). When an 'aura' effect's unit is benched or fainted, anchor() fell back to e.fx/e.fy. Aura effects (renderer.js lines 535, 625, 792) never set fx/fy, so the fallback position was NaN. ctx.createRadialGradient then threw 'The provided double value is non-finite', which killed the rAF frame loop. The battle froze permanently, at t2298 for seed 9001 cavern, right after a switch-in when a burned or buffed unit fainted, and the Emergent runtime-error overlay appeared. Fix applied: anchor() now falls back to e.fx ?? u.pos ?? 0.

issues: Snowflakes are white or pale grey on a near-white snow tilemap, so they are barely visible. Consider a faint blue or grey outline, or a slightly darker flake tint.
The light column and the entering unit at the right edge are partly clipped by the arena bounds. This is cosmetic only.

action_items: Review the testing agent's fix in /app/frontend/src/game/render/archetypeFx.js anchor(). Better still, store fx/fy (the unit's last position) when pushing aura, charge or cloud effects with only fromId, or cache the last good position on the effect each frame.

Harden BattleCanvas frame(): wrap renderer.render(...) in try/catch (log once), so that a render-only exception can never stall the deterministic simulation or freeze the battle. The engine step and the render currently share one rAF callback.
Optionally add Number.isFinite guards before every createRadialGradient call in archetypeFx.js and renderer.js (drawLightPoint, projectile glow).
Update the reference endTick for seed 9001 in docs and handoff: rivalLevel 2 (the default) gives 6690, not 7608.
Minor: L3 and L4 rival avg BST are identical (527/527) for this team. The nextTier pool plateaus, so L4 feels like L3. Snowflake visibility on Snowfield is low.
critical_code_review_comments: renderer.js rAF loop has no error boundary, so any render bug becomes a gameplay freeze. This is the root cause of how severe the aura bug was.

Effects that reference units by fromId only (aura, buffStream, cloud) rely on the unit staying active. Faint, bench and evolve transitions can happen in the same tick the effect is pushed (status burn faint, switch-in).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested checks pass after the 1-line hot-fix (before the fix, every check that needed a seed-9001 battle to finish failed because of the freeze)

seed_data_creation: localStorage arenadex.save.v1 and arenadex.gfx.v1 were seeded per context via add_init_script. window.__battleOverride was set in the init script, with variants switched through sessionStorage.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Seed 9001 [6,94,25,143,130,65] vs [65,64,63,96,97,124] cavern autoPick with save rivalLevel 2 gives player at t6690 (L3 gives 7620, L4 gives 7429). Seed 4242 with Bag thunder-stone ends player at t7779. Live seed 777 L6 NPC: Rhyperior, Mamoswine, Metagross, Tyranitar, Dragonite, Garchomp. There is no window.__dex; compute BST from unit.base stats. To check the freeze regression, run 9001 at 4x and confirm phase reaches 'ended'.
rca of the issue: Repro: run /battle with seed 9001 team [6,94,25,143,130,65] vs [65,64,63,96,97,124] cavern autoPick at 4x. At t2296 a switch-in occurs after a faint. An aura effect whose unit is now fainted is drawn, anchor() returns {x:undefined, y:NaN}, and createRadialGradient throws TypeError inside the rAF frame. The loop stops, the tick stays at 2298 forever and the runtime-error overlay is shown. Mitigation: fall back to the unit's last position (applied), plus a try/catch around render (recommended).
